BC_description: Renamed the forceKillAfterTimeout option to forceKillAfterDelay and moved it from the subprocess.kill() method to the execa() function options. This change affects how graceful exits are handled in termination methods.
Adaptation_method: Set forceKillAfterDelay in the execa options and use subprocess.kill() without it. Example: const subprocess = execa('node', ['file.js'], { forceKillAfterDelay: 1000 }); subprocess.kill('SIGTERM'); // Instead of subprocess.kill('SIGTERM', { forceKillAfterTimeout: 1000 })
